# Paid Time Off Policy

Full-time employees accrue paid time off starting on their first day of employment. PTO accrues at a rate of 1.25 days per month, capped at a maximum balance of 30 days; accrual pauses automatically once an employee reaches the cap and resumes once their balance drops below it. Unused PTO carries over into the next calendar year up to a maximum of 10 days, with any remaining balance above that forfeited on December 31st unless local law requires otherwise.

Employees requesting PTO of five consecutive business days or more should submit the request through the HR portal at least two weeks in advance so their manager has time to arrange coverage. A question about an individual PTO balance or a denied request should be routed as a benefits question to HR business partner within 2 business days of the original request, not escalated directly to HR leadership.
